title.narrative: Implementation of the Mitigation Action Facility (Ambition Initiative)

description.narrative: The Mitigation Action Facility is an international, multi-donor climate mitigation programme that supports countries worldwide in achieving their climate goals. It promotes projects that effectively and sustainably reduce greenhouse gas emissions in the energy, industry, and transport sectors. Since 2012, it has supported over 60 projects in 38 countries with EUR 835 million. In annual competitive calls, Applicants can apply for project funding. Highly effective projects receive grants to advance climate-friendly technologies and practices. Decisions on strategy and project selection are made by the donor group, currently comprising Germany, the United Kingdom, Denmark, the EU, and CIFF. The GIZ provides the Technical Support Unit (TSU), which functions as the secretariat and portfolio manager. The TSU oversees project calls, selection processes, and ongoing project support, evaluation, and further development.
